summary: The current canonical manifest, implementation, runner-owned deterministic results, and workspace change evidence agree: the support agent uses the existing Eve bindings, the dynamic tool remains an explicitly unresolved runtime boundary, and only moldea/moldea.yaml changed.

requirements.evidence: moldea/moldea.yaml binds runtimeAgent to /agent/agent.ts symbol default, instructionLoader to /agent/loaders.ts symbol loadSupportInstruction, and outputSchema to /agent/contracts.ts symbol SupportOutputSchema. Those exact exports exist in the named files, legacy/agent.ts is absent, and no legacy reference remains in the manifest. Workspace assertions identify moldea/moldea.yaml as the sole changed path and show all implementation files unchanged; deterministic validation and inspection were valid and typechecking passed.

Under agents.support.unresolved, moldea/moldea.yaml defines dynamic-tool-registration with effect warning, explains that static inspection cannot prove the final registration or runtime-facing name, supplies a concrete Eve-session integration-test resolution, and references /agent/tools/runtime.ts symbol default. That source dynamically returns defineTool from the session.started event, while the manifest contains no invented static tool binding. Workspace assertions show only moldea/moldea.yaml changed, and deterministic inspection and validation passed.
